intro: The NX Pro Digital Home Locker is your trusted sentinel, combining cutting-edge security with everyday convenience. Keep your valuables safe and accessible, always in plain sight yet beyond reach.

features.title: Digital locking mechanism for personalized safety
features.text: Set a secure, customizable 4–6 digit password, with a master override option. It’s flexibility and security crafted for your peace of mind.

features.title: External USB charging for uninterrupted access
features.text: Never worry about power interruptions. The USB charging port ensures your safe stays active and reliable, even during low battery situations.

features.title: Autolock keypad freeze for tamper prevention
features.text: Four incorrect attempts? The keypad freezes automatically, safeguarding your valuables and deterring unauthorized access with a smart, tamper-proof mechanism.

features.title: Compatible with I-Buzz Alarm
features.text: Want to make your Home Locker even more secure? Consider adding the I-Buzz Alarm Accessory. It's like having an extra pair of eyes watching over your valuables, and it'll sound an alarm if anyone tries to tamper with it.

features.title: Emergency mechanical override for backup access
features.text: Forget your password or run out of power? The reliable backup key ensures you’re never locked out of your locker when it matters most.

features.title: Intelli-light sensor for seamless visibility
features.text: Experience clarity every time you open your safe. The built-in LED light activates automatically, making your valuables easily visible, even in low-light conditions.

name: Nx Pro 25 Litres Steel Digital Home Locker
